sourceTitle: Celebrate 100 years of Colonial Williamsburg online
originalTitle: Celebrate 100 years of Colonial Williamsburg online
author: Mia Nagawiecki

blocks.text: Today, as Colonial Williamsburg marks its 100th anniversary, Google Arts & Culture is sharing new immersive stories and newly digitized cultural artifacts that honor a century of preservation, discovery, and public access. These additions expand on the digital hub we launched earlier this year with The Colonial Williamsburg Foundation to celebrate America’s 250th birthday and bring the rich history of early America online.
blocks.zh: 今天,我们...作为殖民地威廉斯堡 纪念其100周年,Google Arts & Culture 正在分享新的浸润故事 和新数字化的文化文物 纪念一个世纪的保存,发现,与公众接触。今年早些时候我们与殖民地威廉斯堡基金会 一起推出的数字中心 来庆祝美国250岁生日 并带来丰富的历史(原始内容存档于2017-03-21). of early American在线.
blocks.en: Today, as Colonial Williamsburg marks its 100th anniversary, Google Arts & Culture is sharing new immersive stories and newly digitized cultural artifacts that honor a century of preservation, discovery, and public access. These additions expand on the digital hub we launched earlier this year with The Colonial Williamsburg Foundation to celebrate America’s 250th birthday and bring the rich history of early America online.

blocks.text: Discover the latest stories and archives
blocks.zh: 发现最新的故事和档案
blocks.en: Discover the latest stories and archives

blocks.text: We’re introducing three new ways to explore Colonial Williamsburg’s legendary collections, taking you behind the scenes of how history is preserved, studied, and brought to life.
blocks.zh: 我们提出三种新的方法 探索殖民威廉斯堡的传奇藏品,把你带到幕后 如何保存历史,学习,并带来了生命。
blocks.en: We’re introducing three new ways to explore Colonial Williamsburg’s legendary collections, taking you behind the scenes of how history is preserved, studied, and brought to life.

blocks.text: Step inside an immersive online gallery: Learn about the Historic Area’s restoration, which began in 1926. This interactive gallery pairs rare archival photos with modern photography and period music across the first three reconstructed sites: the Governor’s Palace, the Raleigh Tavern, and the Capitol.
blocks.zh: 踏入浸润的网络画廊:了解历史地区的恢复情况,从1926年开始。这个互动画廊将珍贵的档案相片与现代摄影和时期音乐相配,跨越了前三个重建的站点:总督府,拉利酒馆,和首都。
blocks.en: Step inside an immersive online gallery: Learn about the Historic Area’s restoration, which began in 1926. This interactive gallery pairs rare archival photos with modern photography and period music across the first three reconstructed sites: the Governor’s Palace, the Raleigh Tavern, and the Capitol.

blocks.text: Browse more than 3,000 new digital records: Through our ongoing collaboration, a specialized high-resolution tabletop scanner has helped digitize tightly bound volumes, delicate manuscripts, and centuries-old records. Today, we’re launching over 3,000 newly scanned images — including rare issues of the Virginia Gazette, fragile archival records, and special collections assets — making many of these treasures accessible to the public online for the very first time.
blocks.zh: 浏览3000多条新数字记录:通过我们不断的合作,一台专门的高分辨率平面扫描仪帮助将装有紧束的卷数数字化,精细的手稿,和数个世纪的历史记录。今天,我们...包括《弗吉尼亚公报》中少有的几期,脆弱的档案记录,和特殊收藏资产——使许多这些珍宝首次在网上向公众开放.
blocks.en: Browse more than 3,000 new digital records: Through our ongoing collaboration, a specialized high-resolution tabletop scanner has helped digitize tightly bound volumes, delicate manuscripts, and centuries-old records. Today, we’re launching over 3,000 newly scanned images — including rare issues of the Virginia Gazette, fragile archival records, and special collections assets — making many of these treasures accessible to the public online for the very first time.

blocks.text: Read new stories celebrating 100 years: New immersive stories capture the breadth of Colonial Williamsburg’s work and collections. Ranging from rare natural history surveys and early newspapers to reproductions and everyday items, these narratives explore the complex tapestry of American history through the experiences of ordinary people and the vital legacies of historically marginalized voices — and showcase the behind-the-scenes work keeping their histories alive.
blocks.zh: 阅读庆祝100年的新故事:新的浸润故事抓住了殖民威廉斯堡的作品和藏品的广度.从罕见的自然历史调查和早期报纸到复制品和日常物品,这些叙事通过普通人的经验和历史上被边缘化的声音的重要遗产,探讨美国历史的复杂篇章——和展示幕后幕后工作 保存他们的历史。
blocks.en: Read new stories celebrating 100 years: New immersive stories capture the breadth of Colonial Williamsburg’s work and collections. Ranging from rare natural history surveys and early newspapers to reproductions and everyday items, these narratives explore the complex tapestry of American history through the experiences of ordinary people and the vital legacies of historically marginalized voices — and showcase the behind-the-scenes work keeping their histories alive.

blocks.text: Explore newly digitized plates from naturalist Mark Catesby’s 18th-century masterwork, bringing 220 hand-engraved illustrations of North American wildlife and flora into brilliant, high resolution.
blocks.zh: 探索新数字化的板块 从自然学家马克·凯茨比的18世纪主作,将220个北美野生生物和植物的活生生的插图 带到了辉煌的地方高分辨度 。
blocks.en: Explore newly digitized plates from naturalist Mark Catesby’s 18th-century masterwork, bringing 220 hand-engraved illustrations of North American wildlife and flora into brilliant, high resolution.

blocks.text: Step inside the new online gallery to see the restoration of Colonial Williamsburg, spotlighting its first three reconstructed sites: the Governor's Palace, the Raleigh Tavern, and the Capitol.
blocks.zh: 踏入新的在线画廊 以看到恢复殖民地威廉斯堡,突出其前三个重建地点:总督府,拉利酒馆,和首都。
blocks.en: Step inside the new online gallery to see the restoration of Colonial Williamsburg, spotlighting its first three reconstructed sites: the Governor's Palace, the Raleigh Tavern, and the Capitol.

blocks.text: Dive into vivid watercolor and ink pages from folk artist Lewis Miller’s 19th-century sketchbook, offering a rare and powerful window into everyday Virginia life and the domestic slave trade.
blocks.zh: 从民俗艺术家刘易斯·米勒的19世纪草图书中 挖出生动的水彩和墨水页,给弗吉尼亚的日常生活 和国内奴隶贸易 提供了难得而强大的窗口
blocks.en: Dive into vivid watercolor and ink pages from folk artist Lewis Miller’s 19th-century sketchbook, offering a rare and powerful window into everyday Virginia life and the domestic slave trade.

blocks.text: Discover historic American transportation through a rare folio of carriage drawings, showcasing the visual diversity of Colonial Williamsburg's library collections.
blocks.zh: 通过罕见的马车图画 发现美国历史上的运输方式展示殖民地威廉斯堡图书馆藏书的视觉多样性.
blocks.en: Discover historic American transportation through a rare folio of carriage drawings, showcasing the visual diversity of Colonial Williamsburg's library collections.

blocks.text: Uncover the story of “Authentic Colors from Colonial Williamsburg” — a rare book featuring metal pages coated in historic automotive paints inspired by Colonial Williamsburg — and its unique conservation journey.
blocks.zh: 揭开“来自殖民地威廉斯堡的正色”的故事,这是一本罕见的书,以由殖民地威廉斯堡所启发的历史性汽车涂料所涂装的金属页为特色。它独特的保护之旅。
blocks.en: Uncover the story of “Authentic Colors from Colonial Williamsburg” — a rare book featuring metal pages coated in historic automotive paints inspired by Colonial Williamsburg — and its unique conservation journey.

blocks.text: Step into the kitchen with Max Miller’s “Tasting History”
blocks.zh: 与马克斯·米勒的"尝试历史"一起走入厨房.
blocks.en: Step into the kitchen with Max Miller’s “Tasting History”

blocks.text: In partnership with Colonial Williamsburg and YouTube, culinary historian Max Miller, creator of “Tasting History,” visited the living history museum to film an exclusive episode, bringing 18th-century traditions to life. Praising the museum’s meticulous historical accuracy, Miller worked alongside Ivey Boyd, chef de cuisine at the King’s Arms Tavern, to prepare snow eggs (oeufs à la neige). This French dessert was popularized in early America by James Hemings, Thomas Jefferson's enslaved chef, and is served today at Colonial Williamsburg. This collaboration bridges traditional preservation with modern storytelling, inviting a new generation to discover the flavors and stories of early America.
blocks.zh: 与Colonal Williamsburg和YouTube合作,烹饪历史学家马克斯·米勒,创作者“Tasting History,”参观了活的历史博物馆,拍摄了独家的一集,给18世纪的传统带来生命。赞美博物馆的精细历史准确性,米勒和伊维·博伊德一起工作国王酒馆的厨师准备雪地蛋(oeufs à la neige)。这种法国甜点在美国早期被詹姆斯·海明斯所普及,托马斯・杰斐逊的被奴役厨师,今天在殖民地威廉斯堡服役这种合作将传统保存与现代故事连接在一起请新一代来发掘美国早期的口味和故事.
blocks.en: In partnership with Colonial Williamsburg and YouTube, culinary historian Max Miller, creator of “Tasting History,” visited the living history museum to film an exclusive episode, bringing 18th-century traditions to life. Praising the museum’s meticulous historical accuracy, Miller worked alongside Ivey Boyd, chef de cuisine at the King’s Arms Tavern, to prepare snow eggs (oeufs à la neige). This French dessert was popularized in early America by James Hemings, Thomas Jefferson's enslaved chef, and is served today at Colonial Williamsburg. This collaboration bridges traditional preservation with modern storytelling, inviting a new generation to discover the flavors and stories of early America.

blocks.text: Look ahead to the next century of access
blocks.zh: 展望下一个世纪的进入
blocks.en: Look ahead to the next century of access

blocks.text: By expanding access to Colonial Williamsburg’s collections, we’re safeguarding centuries-old treasures while sharing their history with the world. As Colonial Williamsburg enters its second century, we invite you to experience these new stories, archival records, and the living history of early America in a whole new way.
blocks.zh: 通过扩大进入殖民地威廉斯堡的收藏,我们保护着数个世纪的宝藏,随着殖民地威廉斯堡进入第二世纪,我们邀请你 体验这些新故事,档案记录,以及早期美国以全新方式活生生的历史.
blocks.en: By expanding access to Colonial Williamsburg’s collections, we’re safeguarding centuries-old treasures while sharing their history with the world. As Colonial Williamsburg enters its second century, we invite you to experience these new stories, archival records, and the living history of early America in a whole new way.

blocks.text: Explore The Colonial Williamsburg Foundation on Google Arts & Culture today.
blocks.zh: 探索殖民威廉斯堡基金会今日谷歌艺术与文化.
blocks.en: Explore The Colonial Williamsburg Foundation on Google Arts & Culture today.
